newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia could announce Svyazinvest sale next week.
newsitem.headline: Russia could announce Svyazinvest sale next week.

text.p: Russia could announce an auction of a 25 percent plus one share stake in telecoms holding company Svyazinvest at the start of next week, a Federal Property Fund spokesman said on Friday.

"(Deputy Prime Minister and head of the State Property Committee Alfred) Kokh has approved an order for the sale of a 25 percent plus one ordinary share stake in AO Svyazinvest," Vladimir Yefimchik said by telephone.
"The auction could be announced at the beginning of the week."
He declined to give details of the auction before the official publication of its terms and conditions.
The auction, open to both Russian and foreign investors, was due to be announced on June 10, but it has been repeatedly delayed to allow amendments to the conditions of the sale.
The starting price for the stake in the prize company is $1.18 billion dollars.
